answer: One-Time Task Ledger: each identity may perform only tasks whose random nonce was committed on-chain and signed by the requester; the agent must return the nonce plus a fresh, verifier-checked proof of computation tied to that task's state root. Replaying an old answer fails because the state root no longer matches. This removes any harbor for copied solutions.
